open -a Safari 'http://127.0.0.1:8777/mail' || exit 1
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  u=$(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to if (count of documents) > 0 then return URL of front document' 2>/dev/null)
  case "$u" in http://127.0.0.1:8777*) break;; esac
  sleep 0.25
done
osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to activate'
sleep 1
n=$(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to count windows')
t=$(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to count tabs of window 1')
u=$(osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to return URL of front document')
[ "$n" = "1" ] && [ "$t" = "1" ] && case "$u" in http://127.0.0.1:8777*) exit 0;; esac
echo "unexpected Safari state windows=$n tabs=$t url=$u"; exit 1

teardown.applescript: if application "Safari" is running then tell application "Safari" to quit
